about_the_game:
Introducing a single title that includes two of the earliest "Boomerang Survivor" titles!

Includes the endless score attack style of "Boomerang Survivor" and the level-based style of "Boomerang Survivor 2."

You can play this action game, where you defeat enemies with a boomerang, in two different gameplay styles.

It also includes many bonus features, such as "Secret Information" that reveals behind-the-scenes techniques from each game, an "Art Book" with a total of 51 illustrations, an "Audio Selection" where you can listen to excerpts from the series' music, and "Interlude 1→2," a comic that depicts the story between the two games.

Some of these bonus features can be unlocked by fulfilling conditions in the game, so even those who have already played the included titles can enjoy a new challenge.

Enjoy the thrill of wielding a boomerang while powering up the main character, Maple, with items.

*The main focus of this content is the action game. However, the menu screens, bonus features, and manual contain Japanese text. Please note that if you wish to utilize these features, it is recommended that you have knowledge of the language.
